info.title: Deepgram API
info.description: API for Deepgram providing speech-to-text services with various customization options.

post.summary: Transcribe and analyze pre-recorded audio or video

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback URL to provide if you would like your submitted audio to be processed asynchronously.

parameters.name: callback_method
parameters.description: Enable a callback method. Default: false

parameters.name: channels
parameters.description: Number of independent audio channels contained in submitted audio. Only read when a value is provided for encoding.

parameters.name: custom_topic
parameters.description: A custom topic you want the model to detect within your input audio if present. Submit up to one hundred topics.

parameters.name: custom_topic_mode
parameters.description: When `strict`, the model will only return topics submitted using the `custom_topic` param. When `extended`, the model will return its own detected topics in addition to those submitted using the `custom_topic` param.

parameters.name: diarize
parameters.description: Recognize speaker changes. Each word in the transcript will be assigned a speaker number starting at 0. Default: false.

parameters.name: diarize_version
parameters.description: Version of the diarization feature to use. Only used when the diarization feature is enabled (`diarize=true`).

parameters.name: dictation
parameters.description: Spoken dictation commands will be converted to their corresponding punctuation marks. e.g., comma to , Default: false.

parameters.name: detect_entities
parameters.description: Entity Detection identifies and extracts key entities from content in submitted audio. Default: false.

parameters.name: detect_language
parameters.description: Detect the language of the provided audio. Default: false.

parameters.name: detect_topics
parameters.description: Identify and extract key topics. Default: false.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Expected encoding of the submitted audio. If this parameter is set, `sample_rate` must also be specified.

parameters.name: extra
parameters.description: To add an extra parameter in the query string and pass a key-value pair you would like to include in the response.

parameters.name: filler_words
parameters.description: Whether to include words like 'uh' and 'um' in transcription output. Default: false.

parameters.name: intents
parameters.description: Recognizes speaker intent throughout an entire transcript. Returns a list of text segments and the intents found within each segment.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Uncommon proper nouns or other words to transcribe that are not a part of the model's vocabulary. Can send multiple instances in query string.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The BCP-47 language tag that hints at the primary spoken language. Default: en.

parameters.name: measurements
parameters.description: Spoken measurements will be converted to their corresponding abbreviations. e.g., milligram to mg. Default: false.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: AI model used to process submitted audio. Default: base-general.

parameters.name: multichannel
parameters.description: Transcribe each audio channel independently. Default: false.

parameters.name: numerals
parameters.description: Convert numbers from written format (e.g., one) to numerical format (e.g., 1). Default: false.

parameters.name: paragraphs
parameters.description: Split audio into paragraphs. Default: false.

parameters.name: profanity_filter
parameters.description: Remove profanity from the transcript. Default: false.

parameters.name: punctuate
parameters.description: Add punctuation and capitalization to the transcript. Default: false.

parameters.name: redact
parameters.description: Redact sensitive information, replacing redacted content with asterisks (*). Can send multiple instances in query string.

parameters.name: replace
parameters.description: Terms or phrases to search for in the submitted audio and replace. Can send multiple instances in query string.

parameters.name: sample_rate
parameters.description: Sample rate of submitted audio. Required (and only read) when a value is provided for encoding.

parameters.name: smart_format
parameters.description: Apply formatting to transcript output. When set to true, additional formatting will be applied to transcripts to improve readability. Default: false.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Terms or phrases to search for in the submitted audio. Can send multiple instances in query string.

parameters.name: sentiment
parameters.description: Recognizes the sentiment of the entire transcript and detects a shift in sentiment throughout the transcript. Returns a list of text segments and the sentiment found within each segment.

parameters.name: summarize
parameters.description: Summarize content. Default: v2.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag to associate with the request.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: Detects topics throughout an entire transcript. Returns a list of text segments and the topics found within each segment.

parameters.name: utterances
parameters.description: Segment speech into meaningful units based on gaps in speech. Default: false.

parameters.name: utt_split
parameters.description: Length of time in seconds used to split utterances. Default: 0.8.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version of the model to use. Default: latest.

parameters.name: bit_rate
parameters.description: Specifies the bitrate of the audio output. Learn More.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback URL to provide if you would like your submitted text to be processed asynchronously. Learn More.

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: Specifies the file format wrapper for the output audio. Learn More.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Allows you to specify the expected encoding of your audio output. Learn More.

parameters.name: sample_rate
parameters.description: Specifies the sample rate for the output audio. Learn More.

post.summary: Analyze text for various features such as topics, sentiment, and intent

parameters.name: custom_topic_mode
parameters.description: Mode for custom topic detection. Use 'strict' to return only custom topics or 'extended' to include model-detected topics.

parameters.name: intents

parameters.name: language

parameters.name: sentiment
parameters.description: Analyzes the sentiment of the input text.

parameters.name: summarize
parameters.description: Provides a brief summary of the input text.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: Detects topics throughout the input text.

url.description: The URL of the text to be analyzed.
